instrumentation_points.description: Wall-clock time to read trace file from disk or buffer into memory
instrumentation_points.expected_location: trace-parser: file I/O or stream reader entry point
instrumentation_points.implementation: std::chrono::high_resolution_clock around file read / deserialization stream init

instrumentation_points.description: Time to deserialize protobuf trace entries into in-memory structures
instrumentation_points.implementation: Timer around the protobuf ParseFromArray / ParseFromIstream call(s)

instrumentation_points.description: Time to resolve (unique_function_id, pc) lookups and bind static instruction metadata
instrumentation_points.expected_location: trace-parser: static info lookup / metadata binding
instrumentation_points.implementation: Timer around the static metadata resolution and binding loop

instrumentation_points.description: Time to construct threadblock and warp trace data structures from parsed entries
instrumentation_points.expected_location: trace-driven: threadblock construction and warp trace building
instrumentation_points.implementation: Timer around threadblock creation, warp trace construction, and CTA scheduling setup

instrumentation_points.description: Time for get_next_inst and frontend instruction delivery preparation
instrumentation_points.expected_location: trace-driven: warp instruction fetch / frontend delivery loop
instrumentation_points.implementation: Timer around the frontend instruction delivery pipeline (get_next_inst loop)

instrumentation_points.description: Core simulation cycle count and backend execution wall time
instrumentation_points.expected_location: trace-driven: main simulation loop / shader core cycle counter
instrumentation_points.implementation: Existing sim_cycle counter plus wall-clock timer around the main sim loop

instrumentation_points.description: Total wall-clock time from simulation start to completion
instrumentation_points.expected_location: main() or top-level simulation entry point
instrumentation_points.implementation: Top-level timer from sim init to sim exit

per_run_json.frontend_share_definition: (trace_read_s + parse_pb_s + static_bind_s + warp_trace_build_s + tb_load_s + get_next_inst_s) / total_sim_wall_s
per_run_json.note: All 6 frontend buckets are non-overlapping. core_cycle_s stores the raw GPU cycle count (gpu_sim_cycle + gpu_tot_sim_cycle).

overhead_requirements.output: Single JSON file per run, written at simulation exit
